title: General English – Level 05
overview: General English – Level 05 is an upper-intermediate English language program designed to help learners communicate with greater fluency, precision, and independence across professional, academic, and social settings. Building on Level 04, the course develops nuanced expression, confident participation in extended discussions, comprehension of complex authentic material, and coherent written communication. Integrated listening, speaking, reading, and writing practice emphasizes accurate language choices, effective discourse, and strategies for continued progression toward advanced proficiency.
audience: Learners who have completed General English – Level 04 or demonstrate equivalent intermediate proficiency.
Professionals who need to discuss complex workplace topics, contribute to meetings, and communicate with diverse audiences.
Adults preparing for higher-level English study, international work, or English-medium learning environments.
Individuals seeking more confident, natural, and accurate spoken and written English.
methodology: The course follows a communicative, task-based approach combining authentic audio and reading texts, facilitated discussion, problem-solving, presentations, structured writing workshops, grammar-in-context practice, and pronunciation coaching. Learners complete collaborative tasks, role-plays, peer reviews, and short performance assessments. Instructor feedback and individualized practice address fluency, accuracy, coherence, and pragmatic language use.
competencies: Comprehension of extended speech, complex arguments, and implied meaning in familiar and unfamiliar contexts.
Fluent discussion, persuasive speaking, and appropriate interaction in professional and social situations.
Flexible control of upper-intermediate grammar, vocabulary, register, and discourse markers.
Critical reading of authentic articles, reports, and opinion texts.
Coherent, well-structured professional and general-purpose writing.
Effective pronunciation, intonation, and communication repair strategies.
Self-monitoring, editing, and independent language-development skills.
objectivesIntro: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Follow extended conversations, presentations, and interviews, identifying viewpoints, supporting evidence, and implied meaning.
Express and defend opinions, compare alternatives, and participate constructively in complex discussions.
Use advanced tense relationships, modals, conditionals, passive constructions, and clause structures with greater accuracy.
Apply a broad range of topic-specific vocabulary, collocations, idiomatic expressions, and appropriate register.
Analyze authentic reading materials and distinguish facts, opinions, assumptions, and persuasive techniques.
Produce organized reports, formal emails, proposals, and extended opinion texts with clear cohesion.
Deliver structured presentations and respond confidently to questions and challenges.
Identify recurring language weaknesses and implement a personal improvement plan.
